messages:
Lena: Quick heads-up — Cedarlane renewal in 21 days. Their usage curve flattened two sprints ago and power-user cohort adoption is near zero. We should run a short stabilization pilot rather than a full save play.

Omar: Got the dashboard. Active seats unchanged but feature toggles for advanced rerank/embeddings are OFF for their org. Looks like they never turned them on after trial.

Priya: Suggestion: 2-week "power-user stabilization" pilot: 1) 45m hands-on session for power users + recorded clip, 2) enable flags for a scoped team, 3) 14-day usage credit tied to pilot, 4) a tiny sandbox test that proves search precision improvements.

Ben: +1. Also propose a very small acceptance test we can run during session: 10 representative queries vs their baseline index and measure MRR lift. If >10% improvement, offer a tailored 3-month discount.

Lena: Draft outreach to Cedarlane (short):
```
Hi Maya,
We noticed your team hasn't enabled the advanced search features you signed up for. Can we run a short 45-minute session to enable them for a few power users, run a quick sandbox test, and share concrete metrics? We9ll include a 14-day usage credit for the pilot. Wed/Thu next week?
Thanks, Lena (CSM)
```

Omar: I can toggle the flags for an org-scoped experiment. Need the org ID and an alias for the pilot team. Also can set a temporary lower qps limit so they don9t spike cost.

Priya: I'll own the enablement session and the MRR quick-eval. Ben, can you prepare the 10-query benchmark list based on their 30d top queries?

Ben: Yep. Can extract top queries + pick 10 that represent high-value intents. Will do before the session.

renewal-bot: Reminder — Cedarlane contract renewal in 21 days. Risk: MEDIUM-HIGH. Last touchpoint: 2025-05-14.

Lena: Acceptance criteria for success pilot: a) pilot cohort shows +15% MAU for targeted workflow, b) MRR lift >=10% on benchmark, c) at least 2 power users adopt templates. If all three met, propose 6-month rollforward and discount to AM.

Omar: If they still ask to downgrade, propose an efficient downgrade path: keep embeddings index read-only, swap heavy batch jobs to nightly queue, and pin to a single smaller model family with re-ingest notes for resume. Provide a one-click export of their index blobs.

Priya: Quick checklist before outreach:
- confirm org ID and power-user list
- pre-run one sample query to demo latency/quality
- prepare 45m agenda + recording link template
- create 14-day credit code

Lena: I'll send outreach in the morning and book Priya. If Cedarlane accepts, Omar please enable flags 24h prior and Ben prep queries.

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll also prepare a short slide with before/after examples and the rollback steps.

Lena: Thanks team — lets aim to have the pilot live within 7 days. If adoption doesn't lift within 10 days after the pilot, escalate to AM for renewal negotiation.
